plan.title: SRC-AWD-002 — Award one bid and approve

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS as required for this state.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the named vendor.
Verify all available line items and one vendor are selected for award.
Create and submit the award proposal for Vendor A.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award using the available pending-approver flow and the required remark.
Complete the award approval flow and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Verify the resulting purchase order contains the awarded line with quantity 10.
